prompts.body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production sprite animation sheet for the existing Terraria Boss torso restraint. Image 1 is the original project-owned rig atlas, identity reference. Use ONLY the pointed Gothic ivory torso in the TOP LEFT, with cathedral spires, two shoulder sockets, the black empty almond-shaped central cavity, asymmetric cracked ivory armor, bronze fittings and dark wine hanging tissue. Draw EIGHT successive animation drawings of this exact torso subtly forcing itself wider under tension: the paired plates articulate slightly, the central opening and folds genuinely change contour, the left and right material bends at slightly different times. Not eight rotated or scaled copies. Keep the original elongated pointed silhouette, silhouette scale, shoulder socket positions and topmost crown fixed; do not add a face or human body. Frame0 relaxed; frames1,2,3,4 increasingly tense with the opening widening up to 12 percent; frames5,6,7 recover toward frame0 with delayed folds. Exactly FOUR columns TWO rows on a square 2048x2048 transparent PNG. Each cell 512x1024, same orthographic front camera. Each torso occupies x40..472,y48..928 and shoulder sockets remain at consistent positions. No overall rotation or translation. Full asset not cropped, small transparent margin, no grid lines, numbers, captions, glows, effects, background, cast shadow or checkerboard. Match existing ivory/black/bronze/wine colors; high-quality restrained material readable at Terraria Boss distance. Genuine transparent alpha. No other atlas parts.
